description: Retrieval benchmark for the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (as enacted). Each query names the one section that best answers it; Recall@10 is measured against this release's own retrieval documents. Queries mix everyday and legal wording and were checked against the approved text on 3 November 2026.
